26: And in the corresponding case concerning payment to a prostitute - If one cohabited with a harlot and afterward gave her her fee (etnan), the animal is permitted for sacrifice. That since he did not give it at the time of the intercourse, when he later gave it to her that lamb is considered only an ordinary gift.
If he gave her but did not cohabit yet, etc. — the Gemara goes on to explain this.
